results.term_definition: A dark nebula is a cool cloud of gas and dust in space which blocks much of the light from stars and bright nebulae behind it, and therefore appears dark. It is the dust which blocks the light from behind, even though dust makes up only 1% of the matter in the nebula. Dark nebulae block visible and ultraviolet light, but it is possible to see through them by looking in infrared light. The best-known example is the Horsehead Nebula in the constellation of Orion.
